scenarios.scenario: Analysis — Diagnose why code signing fails with access denied

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy config

scenarios.reasoning: Methodical, evidence-driven diagnosis that nails the glob-over-shared-folder root cause and gives actionable, well-ordered fixes. Falls short of excellent because the specific access-denied mechanism differs from the expected read-only/hard-link explanation and the non-determinism rate is asserted rather than substantiated.
